about_the_role: BrightLoop is a small product team building education software. Everyone here works across the stack, from the database schema to the button the student clicks.
responsibilities: Own features end to end, from data model and API through to the user interface.
Build React frontends and Node.js or Python backends that serve them.
Design database schemas and write the queries that back your features.
Implement authentication, session handling and role-based access control.
Deploy and debug your own work, with support from the team.
Keep the codebase consistent through code review and shared conventions.
required_skills: Strong JavaScript fundamentals across both browser and server environments.
Practical React experience building multi-page application interfaces.
Backend development with Node.js and Express, or with Python and FastAPI.
Ability to design REST APIs and connect them to a frontend.
SQL knowledge and comfort designing relational schemas.
Confident use of HTML and CSS for layout and styling.
Daily use of Git for version control.
preferred_skills: TypeScript across the stack for shared type definitions.
Experience with MongoDB as well as PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with Tailwind CSS for rapid interface development.
Authentication experience with JWT or OAuth providers.
Exposure to Docker and CI/CD for repeatable deployment.
Automated testing habits on both frontend and backend.
Interest in System Design as the product scales.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering or a related field.
At least one full-stack project you built and can demonstrate live.
